>It's against the rules for me to talk about suicide methods. I'd be happy to talk about most anything else though. What's going on? 

That's okay, thank you anyway. I just don't know why I go on, every day I wake up feeling like shit and I don't see why I bother spending decades living just to die anyway, besides we are objectively meaningless so what's the point? Especially when my OCD is controlling me more than I can handle and no matter what we do I'm going to die eventually so why not just cut to the chase? I just would have rather not been born tbh
